metadata.case_name: NG TIN CHUEN v. 黃宗強 AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_after: gardener (briefly); thereafter freelance light construction work (8-10 days/month)

injuries.description: the plaintiff fell from a collapsing working platform on 19 March 2010 and suffered a fracture of the left calcaneum.
source: the plaintiff fell from a collapsing working platform on 19 March 2010 and suffered a fracture of the left calcaneum.

manifestations.description: left hind foot pain on walking for 15 minutes
no finding of muscle wasting (on physical examination)
x-ray showed healed fracture in acceptable alignment with preserved joint space (but with mild irregularity of the articular surface)
reduced range of movement and stiffness of the left ankle
could no longer jog or hike
would have left foot pain upon prolonged walking or exertion
would find significant difficulties and left foot pain if he walked on uneven ground for a long period of time

treatments_received: treated with a short leg cast
treatments_future: future medical and travelling expenses HK$1,000

losses.description: fracture of the left calcaneum with reduced range of movement and stiffness of the left ankle

left hind foot pain on walking for 15 minutes; reduced range of movement and stiffness of the left ankle; left foot pain upon prolonged walking or exertion; significant difficulties and left foot pain if walking on uneven ground for a long period

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: could no longer jog or hike

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Chi Shing v Chan Siu Kuen & others
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff suffered a fracture of lumbar vertebrate as well as a fracture of calcaneum which required surgery.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lau Kin Wah v Lam Shu Kan
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff suffered a fracture of calcaneum which required surgery, hospitalization for 6 weeks and the patient was on crutches for 2 years.
